notes: Player lost or not, mission won flag 0/1/0x80, high-score qualification 0/1/0xff, mission 12, ordinary, 13, 0, -1 and 0x7fff, difficulty 1-3 and out-of-range words, scores across the eight-digit range. The original sprintf runs; window and widget lookups, the player-entry search 0x11770, high-score load/check, list select, widget refresh, the next-mission starter 0x4aa0 and the pointer release are loggers; 0xa7588 logs the first 24 bytes of its text instead of its stack address.
